notes: Runs the repo's three PROC LOGISTIC models (binary Qualified~Training scores, backward-stepwise selection, and multinomial Training~scores with link=glogit) plus the PROC FREQ classification tables. Original read Drivers from an SPSS .sav import; this bundle builds an equivalent 40-row Drivers dataset in-line, sampled from the repo's own DriversLicenseData.csv. Worked around a Jenner OUTPUT-statement parser bug on PREDPROBS=(individual) (documented valid PROC LOGISTIC syntax) by dropping the parens to PREDPROBS=individual; filed as a regression test upstream.
